summary: First-pass full e2e test of PlaySharp MVP. Backend (15/15 pytest) and frontend (all flows) PASS. Backend endpoints, validation, sorting, filters, seed-data, and ObjectId exclusion verified. Frontend home/pricing/contact/demo/leaderboard/games all render and integrate with backend. Phaser games initialize canvases on both /demo and direct /games routes. No critical issues.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py weekly period filter compares createdAt as ISO strings (string > string). Works because all docs are stored as ISO strings, but consider storing as native BSON datetime so $gte uses proper datetime semantics and indexing is more reliable.
Pydantic v2 deprecation: @app.on_event('startup') / 'shutdown' are deprecated in newer FastAPI; consider lifespan context manager. Non-blocking but emits warnings.
Score model accepts score up to 10000 but business rules cap reaction at 1000 and decision at 100 — server does not enforce upper-bound per gameType. Low priority.
No rate limiting on /api/contact and /api/score — vulnerable to spam in production. MVP-acceptable.
/api/contact GET (list) is publicly accessible with no auth — fine for MVP demo, but should be locked down before launch.

Frontend routes /games/reaction and /games/decision render a setup form first (name + club) before showing the canvas. Review request implied canvas should be present immediately; current behaviour is actually better UX, but worth confirming with PM.
seed_data_creation: Backend self-seeds 40 sample scores (20 reaction + 20 decision) on startup. Tests added a few TEST_-prefixed contacts and scores for verification (no cleanup, harmless for demo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All functional acceptance criteria from the review request are met. /app/backend/tests/test_playsharp_api.py is the regression suite (15 tests, run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml). For UI: data-testids are excellent — use leaderboard-tab-{reaction|decision}, leaderboard-club-filter, leaderboard-period-filter, contact-input-{name|email|club|message}, contact-submit-button, demo-input-name, demo-club-{Club-With-Hyphens}, demo-start-button, demo-skip-{reaction|decision}, reaction-game-canvas, decision-game-canvas, decision-action-{pass|shoot|dribble}, navbar-mobile-toggle, nav-mobile-{home|demo|leaderboard|pricing|contact}. Direct game routes /games/reaction and /games/decision require player setup before canvas appears.
